encode_string_to_bytes: encode a string into space-separated byte characters using the Bytes BPE encoder
decode_bytes_to_string: decode space-separated byte characters back into the original string using the Bytes BPE encoder
register_bytes_bpe: register the Bytes BPE encoder with fairseq using the register_bpe decorator
byte_encode_utf8: encode a UTF-8 string into byte characters using the byte_encode utility function
smart_byte_decode_recovery: decode byte characters with dynamic programming recovery for broken sequences using smart_byte_decode
